title: Infrastructure: knowledge-base processing
purpose: This subsystem normalizes raw scraped Markdown into standardized canonical Markdown (cleaning, exact-duplicate detection, metadata extraction/inference, frontmatter formatting) and provides loading/parsing utilities used by the RAG index build. It supplies the document-loading conventions (Markdown with YAML-style frontmatter) that the production ingestion path expects, plus a diagnostics tracer for RAG retrieval/inference timing that is currently dormant. It is an offline, pre-indexing concern: it runs at knowledge-import time rather than at query time.

files.purpose: Public package facade that re-exports the four knowledge-normalization components (MetadataExtractor, MarkdownTextCleaner, DuplicateDetector, KnowledgeNormalizationPipeline).
files.notes: Facade only, no logic; imports every module in the package so `from campus_helpdesk.infrastructure.knowledge import KnowledgeNormalizationPipeline` works.

files.purpose: Detects exact duplicate documents during ingestion by tracking SHA-256 hashes of normalized content.

terms.definition: hashlib.sha256 hex digest of stripped UTF-8 content; used as the identity key to detect byte-identical documents.
Skipping a document whose normalized body text was already registered by this detector instance, tracked in an in-memory set of hashes.

files.notes: Deduplication state is in-memory and per-instance only (no persistence), so duplicates are NOT detected across separate pipeline runs; the pipeline constructs a fresh DuplicateDetector on every run. Hash covers content only, not source path.

files.purpose: Extracts, parses, and infers document metadata into a standardized dict and formats it as a YAML-style frontmatter header.

terms.definition: A '---'-delimited header block at the top of a Markdown file holding metadata (title, category, etc.); parsed here with a naive key: value line splitter, not real YAML.
Filling in missing title/category fields from the first H1 heading or, failing that, from the source file's stem (underscores/hyphens replaced) and parent folder name.
The standardized metadata dict augmented with word_count (body word count), sha256, and processed_at (UTC ISO timestamp) for every document.

files.notes: Frontmatter parser is a line-by-line 'key: value' splitter that strips surrounding quotes; it does not handle YAML lists or nested structures. Reuses FRONTMATTER_PATTERN (a regex) to separate header from body. Shared by two consumers: the normalization pipeline and the production loader infrastructure/rag/markdown_loader.py (MarkdownKnowledgeLoader), which uses extract() plus FRONTMATTER_PATTERN to strip the header before vector indexing. MarkdownKnowledgeLoader passes settings.knowledge_source_path / knowledge_max_file_size_bytes context when it calls this class.

files.purpose: Orchestrates the knowledge normalization pipeline: clean each raw Markdown file, deduplicate, extract metadata, and write canonical Markdown with a frontmatter header.

terms.definition: The ordered sequence clean -> duplicate-check -> metadata extract -> canonical-Markdown write applied to every Markdown file under an input directory.
Standardized Markdown files (cleaned body plus YAML-style frontmatter header) written to data/canonical_markdown, the documented input source for the production FAISS/BM25 index build.

files.notes: Not invoked by src/ or by ingest.py; only exercised by tests/unit/test_knowledge_normalization.py. Production ingestion assumes canonical Markdown already exists in data/canonical_markdown (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md tells operators to place files there and run campus_helpdesk.ingest). process_directory counts every skipped file as 'duplicates_skipped', including files that merely failed to read (process_file returns None on read errors), conflating read failures with duplicates. Canonical output is flattened to source_path.name, so files with the same name in different raw subdirectories overwrite each other. Cleaned body (not raw content) is used for the duplicate hash, while MetadataExtractor re-parses the original raw content.

files.purpose: Cleans and standardizes raw Markdown: strips frontmatter and HTML tags, normalizes line endings, removes trailing whitespace, and collapses blank lines.

terms.definition: Converting Windows CRLF and lone CR line endings to Unix LF so content hashes and diffs are consistent across platforms.
Removing '<...>' tags via regex while preserving line breaks, to clean web-scraped content before indexing.

files.notes: All cleaning is regex-based; HTML_TAG_PATTERN = '<[^>]+>' is fragile for malformed tags and angle brackets inside code or math. Strips an existing frontmatter header from the content (so cleaning runs before MetadataExtractor re-extracts from the original raw content). Compresses runs of 3+ newlines to a single blank line and returns content stripped.

files.purpose: Legacy Markdown loader that reads a file with YAML frontmatter and splits it into a (metadata_dict, body_text) tuple.

terms.definition: A '---'-delimited header parsed here with yaml.safe_load, with a fallback to a naive line-by-line key: value splitter when YAML parsing fails.

A loader superseded for production by MarkdownKnowledgeLoader (infrastructure/rag/markdown_loader.py); it survives mainly for tests and does not enforce the knowledge-root path or max-file-size rules.

files.notes: Imports yaml lazily inside load_document. Only referenced by tests/unit/test_sprint1_core.py; no src/ production code imports it. Reads files with open(..., errors='ignore') so undecodable bytes are silently dropped. Raises FileNotFoundError (missing file) and OSError (read failure). Frontmatter split uses a naive content.split('---', 2), so '---' inside the body can mis-split.

files.purpose: Thread-safe singleton diagnostic tracer that records per-request retrieval and inference timing plus candidate sources for RAG performance monitoring.
key_symbols: log_retrieval_step(span, vector_candidates, bm25_candidates, rrf_output, confidence_score, latency_ms)

terms.definition: A per-request context dict (trace_id, query, start_time, retrieval/inference sub-results) accumulating diagnostics for one RAG request.
A uuid4 identifier tagging one request's retrieval and inference diagnostic data.
A JSON-lines file (logs/retrieval_diagnostics.jsonl) to which completed spans are appended, with per-phase latency and the first five candidate source paths.
The reciprocal rank fusion result list logged next to raw vector-candidate and BM25-candidate sources to diagnose ranking behavior.

terms.description: DiagnosticTracer enforces one process-wide instance via a __new__-based singleton, shared through get_tracer().
terms.definition: DiagnosticTracer enforces one process-wide instance via a __new__-based singleton, shared through get_tracer().

files.notes: DORMANT: no production src/ code calls get_tracer()/start_span()/log_retrieval_step()/log_inference_step(); it is only exercised by tests (tests/unit/test_sprint1_core.py, tests/integration/test_sprint2_pipeline.py). Appends JSONL without rotation or size cap. Docstring claims thread-safety but there are no locks. The answer parameter of log_inference_step is accepted but never written into the span or the log line. Only the first 5 candidate sources per phase are kept, so it is a coarse view of retrieval behavior.

data_flow: Two distinct flows. (1) Offline normalization: KnowledgeNormalizationPipeline reads raw .md files from data/raw, cleans each with MarkdownTextCleaner, deduplicates with DuplicateDetector, extracts/infers metadata with MetadataExtractor, and writes canonical .md with a frontmatter header into data/canonical_markdown. This pipeline is currently run only by tests. (2) Production ingestion: the CLI entry point campus_helpdesk.ingest (src/campus_helpdesk/ingest.py) builds the FAISS/BM25 index via CanonicalIndexBuilder, which loads data/canonical_markdown through MarkdownKnowledgeLoader (infrastructure/rag/markdown_loader.py). That loader reuses MetadataExtractor to parse/infer metadata and to strip the frontmatter header, honoring settings.knowledge_source_path and settings.knowledge_max_file_size_bytes, then emits KnowledgeDocument objects to the chunker and similarity store. KBLoader provides an alternate legacy (metadata, body) loader used only in tests. DiagnosticTracer, a singleton, would append retrieval/inference spans to logs/retrieval_diagnostics.jsonl but is not wired into the RAG pipeline, so the runtime path never calls it.
external_deps: Standard library only for the rest: hashlib, re, datetime, pathlib, typing, json, time, uuid, logging
risks: KnowledgeNormalizationPipeline is effectively dead in production: no src/ code or ingest.py calls it (only a unit test does), so canonical Markdown must be placed in data/canonical_markdown manually; the raw->canonical normalization step is not part of the shipped ingestion path.
DuplicateDetector deduplication is in-memory and per-run only; exact duplicates across separate pipeline runs are never caught.
MetadataExtractor and KBLoader both parse frontmatter with naive key:value splitters (regex/str.split) rather than real YAML, so lists, nested values, and '---' inside the body are mishandled.

pipeline.process_directory counts unreadable files (which return None) as 'duplicates_skipped', silently conflating read errors with real duplicates; canonical output is flattened by filename, so same-named files in different raw subdirectories overwrite each other.
MarkdownTextCleaner strips HTML tags with the fragile regex '<[^>]+>', which can mangle angle brackets in code or math content.
KBLoader is legacy/test-only and reads files with errors='ignore', silently dropping undecodable bytes; it is not the production loader.
DiagnosticTracer is dormant (only tests call it), appends JSONL with no rotation or size cap, claims thread-safety without locks, and drops the answer field from log_inference_step.
